title: Administrative penalties.
bodyText: Any person who violates this chapter or the rules adopted pursuant thereto may be fined not more than $2,500 for each violation.
bodyHtml: [§460J-28]  Administrative penalties.  Any person who violates this chapter or the rules adopted pursuant thereto may be fined not more than $2,500 for each violation. [L 1986, c 126, pt of §7]
